facts.text: Banyan Tree Samui overlooks the Gulf of Thailand and sits amid jungle on a private bay in Lamai.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the azure waters of the Gulf of Thailand, Banyan Tree Samui is nestled amid the lush jungle of a private bay in Lamai.

facts.text: The resort sits on a private hill overlooking Lamai Bay, enveloped by jungle greenery.
facts.excerpt: Enveloped by lush jungle greenery on a private hill overlooking Lamai Bay

facts.text: The villas all feature private pools and come in a range of configurations, sizes and views.
facts.excerpt: Our villas feature private pools, and come in a range of configurations, sizes and views.

facts.text: A dedicated Villa Host is provided for all villa types.
facts.excerpt: Yes, a dedicated Villa Host is provided for all villa types at Banyan Tree Samui

facts.text: The Rainforest is a hydrotherapy experience combining European spa and hydrothermal therapy with Asian wellness.
facts.excerpt: Combining the best of European spa and hydrothermal therapy with the essence of Asian wellness, The Rainforest is a complete hydrotherapy experience

facts.text: The Rainforest is a hydrotherapy circuit of heat and cool stages, from sauna to vitality pool.
facts.excerpt: Embark on a hydrotherapy circuit of heat and cool stages - from sauna to vitality pool.

facts.text: Complimentary beach activities include kayaking, stand-up paddle boarding, sailing and snorkelling in the house reef steps from the shoreline.
facts.excerpt: complimentary activities on offer including kayaking, stand-up paddle boarding, sailing or snorkeling in the house reef located just steps away from the shoreline

facts.text: The resort has a house reef in its bay, accessible from its private beach.
facts.excerpt: Our resort has a house reef in our bay, which is accessible from our private beach.

facts.text: Guests can travel on the resort's private speedboat, Sense of the Sea.
facts.excerpt: Create your own perfect day in paradise travelling onboard our private speedboat, Sense of the Sea.

facts.text: The Royal Banyan Ocean Pool Villa has an infinity pool with an adjacent jet pool.
facts.excerpt: Refresh in the cool waters of your infinity pool or soak in the warmth of the adjacent jet pool.

facts.text: The Sanctuary Residence has a living area interlinking two one-bedroom villas.
facts.excerpt: an elegantly-appointed living area interlinking two one-bedroom villas

facts.text: The Horizon Hillcrest Pool Villa has an extensive outdoor lounge, a sky-suspended swimming pool and open-villa living quarters.
facts.excerpt: an extensive outdoor lounge, sky-suspended swimming pool and open-villa living quarters

facts.text: The Kids' Club is for children ages four to 12, with activities including arts and crafts and games.
facts.excerpt: Our Kids' Club is available for children ages four to 12 and features a variety of activities for entertainment including arts and crafts as well as games.

facts.text: A Kids' Pool sits next to the Kids' Club and the beachfront lawn.
facts.excerpt: our spacious Kids' Pool, adjacent to our Kids' Club and beachfront lawn, delivers a perfect space for children

facts.text: Saffron serves authentic Thai cuisine with performances of Menora, a traditional dance of southern Thailand.
facts.excerpt: Delight in an evening at Saffron for authentic Thai cuisine and performances of 'Menora', a traditional dance of southern Thailand.

facts.text: Destination Dining is set at the main pool with the bay behind it or at Infinity Point, which looks over the resort.
facts.excerpt: at our main pool backdropped by coconut trees and the stunning bay or at the Infinity Point where you get a picturesque view of our resort and the natural wonders of the island

facts.text: Guests can learn muay thai, or Thai kickboxing, in indoor or outdoor classes.
facts.excerpt: Learn the fighting techniques and cultural practices of 'muay thai', or Thai kickboxing, with our indoor or outdoor classes.

facts.text: Complimentary yoga, stretching and sun salutation classes are led by an in-house instructor.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary yoga, stretching and sun salutation classes are available under the tutelage of our in-house instructor.

facts.text: The resort is about 5 km from the main area of Lamai and about 15 km from the main area of Chaweng.
facts.excerpt: We are located approximately 5 km away from the main area of Lamai and approximately 15 km away from the main area of Chaweng.

facts.text: The resort says January through October typically bring clear skies, sunny weather and calm seas.
facts.excerpt: The best time to visit Banyan Tree Samui is from January through October, as these months typically feature clear skies, sunny weather, and calm seas ideal for swimming and outdoor activities.

facts.text: An on-site Sustainability Manager with a marine biology background works with Thailand's Department of Marine and Coastal Resources to protect the local coral reef.
facts.excerpt: Banyan Tree Samui features an on-site Sustainability Manager with a background in marine biology who collaborates closely with Thailand's Department of Marine and Coastal Resources to monitor and protect the local coral reef.

facts.text: The Wellbeing Sanctuary combines pool villas, dining, spa treatments and practice spaces into one wellbeing journey.
facts.excerpt: Our Wellbeing Sanctuary combines spacious pool villas, bespoke dining offerings, blissful spa treatments and multifunctional practice spaces into one exclusive wellbeing journey.

facts.text: Banyan Tree Connections is a private holistic wellbeing journey for two.
facts.excerpt: a private holistic wellbeing journey for two designed to nurture togetherness

facts.text: The resort incorporates Thai traditions and culture into its accommodations, spa and experiences.
facts.excerpt: Banyan Tree Samui incorporates the traditions and culture of Thailand into every aspect, from our accommodations to our spa to the experiences we facilitate.

facts.text: The spa calls The Rainforest Samui's first hydrotherapy spa.
facts.excerpt: journey through Samui’s first hydrotherapy spa, The Rainforest
